violations.msg: SW1 (C49023761) has no manufacturer datasheet and the {1,2}=BTN / {3,4}=GND wiring rests only on the LCSC vendor symbol's asserted internal bridge - if the physical part pairs by column ({1,4}/{2,3}) the button is permanently closed and PB0 is stuck low (user-button function dead; no damage, bring-up otherwise unaffected).

UMW USBLC6-2SC6 specifies VRWM/operating voltage 5.0V on the I/O and VBUS pins but USB VBUS may legally reach 5.25V, so leakage and clamp margins are unspecified in the top 0.25V of the input range (no damage - VBR min 6V; ST-brand alternate C7519 is rated 5.25V and is a drop-in at order time).
